# NEOLINE Israel — archived restore points (20 November 2026)

A verified restoration point was created **before** developing the new Smart Hub:

- **Current pre-upgrade checkpoint:** `restore/2026-11-20-before-smart-hub-upgrade` at `6e33c6c6e9cbafe3ab0f9c435110f137a3ccdc5e`.
- **Pre-Arabic stable checkpoint:** `backup/2026-11-20-before-arabic-theory`.
- **Long-term baseline:** `backup/2026-11-18-before-full-cleanup`.

The historical short-lived backup branch names listed below were retired to simplify
the repository; the commit SHA is recorded here before ref cleanup. The project
files and Git history are not deliberately rewritten. Short-lived branch commits
were made from earlier `main` states; a SHA can be inspected in GitHub's commit view.
If a SHA is no longer available from git object storage, use one of the retained
long-term restore branches instead.

Restore instructions: open GitHub, browse an available commit or retained branch,
create a new branch from its SHA, and then deploy/merge only after checking the site.
